summary: TPG Private Equity Opportunities, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting a routine unregistered sale of limited partnership units under its continuous private offering. On September 1, 2026, the Fund sold 2,041,663 Class I units for $70,797,707 and 932,199 Class S units for $31,979,592, aggregating $102.8 million, including 840,215 Class I units issued to Feeder TE. The broader T-POP Fund Complex issued interests totaling roughly $146.7 million. Sales relied on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D exemptions; Transactional NAV governs pricing. No special-situation event, deal terms, or board recommendation arise.
